notes: Decision-LWE specialization of the original free-depth corollary: choose a≈2 log₂n and b=n/a. Then q^b=2^{n+o(n)} and m=exp(O(n/log₂⁴n))=2^{o(n)}. The simplified Search-LWE Theorem 1 fixes a≈log₂n and instead gives coefficient 2; do not conflate the two statements.
